subject: SOURCE FORMAT directive
notes: kb/Work PB1362 (w70b): '2) The default reference format of a compilation group is fixed form.' (cite.py --check 7.3.24.3 -> OK §7.3.24.3 2)). The initial format is now a SELECTION whose default is FIXED at every entry point (CLI --source-format, CompilerDriver.Options.SourceFormat, Frontend.InitialFormat); free and the structural auto-detection (IsFixedForm) are the §4.2.10 3) implementor-defined selection mechanism for a nonstandard behavior ('provided that standard-conforming behavior is also implemented and that an implementor-defined mechanism exists for selection of the nonstandard behavior', cite.py --check 4.2.10 -> OK §4.2.10 3)), documented in docs/CONFORMANCE.md DOC-A.1-158. Probes rf7/rf8/sf_p1/sf_p2/sf_p3 (letters or blank in the sequence area, tags past margin R, a '*' comment line) now compile fixed and print their OK lines; under --source-format auto they still fail as before, which is the extension's documented hazard.
